$comment: Lighthouse CI for the dashboard (P1.7-T02). /settings/theme is the representative route. It needs a session, and Phase 1 has only the development adapter, so this measures `next dev` with a session from tools/scripts/lighthouse-sign-in.cjs (the dev tenant switcher): the numbers are indicative until a production session adapter exists. Assertions warn first; change to error after two green weeks. Lighthouse runs its default mobile profile. A navigation run cannot measure INP, so Total Blocking Time (200 ms) stands in for the INP budget in the lab.
